title: Finite and integral compact-support composition on localizing categories
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y,Z$, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ annihilated by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E\}$, regarded as a condensed ring with the discrete topology for $A$ and its $\ell$-adic topology otherwise [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every standing scheme $T$, use the pulled-back coefficient ring $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and module-object category $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategory $\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and its localizing closure $\mathcal T_T=\Loc(\Dctf(T,\Lambda))$ in this ordinary unbounded derived category [sk-def-localizing-closure].

Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type $k$-morphisms. For $h=f,g,gf$, let $Rh_!$ be the functor $\mathcal T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}\to\mathcal T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence], computed by $Rr_*D(j_!)$ for a compactification $h=rj$, with $j$ quasi-compact open and $r$ proper [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$Rg_!\circ Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(gf)_!: \mathcal T_X\longrightarrow\mathcal T_Z,$$
compatible with the compactification comparison isomorphisms of [det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle], and hence independent of the compactifications under those comparisons.

source.place: Proposition sk-thm-sf-comp-composition, clause (1), finite and integral coefficient cases; proof sk-thm-sf-comp-composition.proof.md, The composition isomorphism and Canonicity and associativity (compactification-independence only).

proof.text: Embed the finite/integral coefficient alternatives into IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient. Apply sk-prop-sf-existence separately to every compactification of f, g and gf and retain its preservation witness. Finite type and separatedness give the quasi-compact and quasi-separated base instances.

Use lem-sfb-nonrational-composition-seed to obtain one triple and a composition isomorphism β. Use det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle for f, g and gf, and lift its comparisons through the full localizing inclusions. Define α for an arbitrary triple by comparison to the seed triple, followed by β and comparison from the seed composite to the requested composite.

The private transportComposition lemma proves compatibility with each lifted comparison: naturality moves the first comparison past the second, the f and g cocycle equations combine the incoming factors, and the gf cocycle combines the outgoing factors. The calculation is valid for all triples, including nondense compactifications. The normalization clause of det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle with the common dense refinement d and its identity projection identifies the comparison c → d with the actual refinement component, using lem-sfb-compactification-refinement-component-id. Taking underlying morphisms of the transport equality is precisely the displayed simultaneous refinement square.

theorem exists_nonrationalLocalizingLowerShriekComposition
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (_hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] :
    ∃ (hf : ∀ (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f)
          (K : DerivedCategory (CategoryTheory.Mod
            (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))),
          localizingClosureProEtale Λ X K → localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y
            ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c.obj.obj).obj K))
      (hg : ∀ (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification g)
          (K : DerivedCategory (CategoryTheory.Mod
            (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))),
          localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y K → localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z
            ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c.obj.obj).obj K))
      (hgf : ∀ (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification (f ≫ g))
          (K : DerivedCategory (CategoryTheory.Mod
            (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))),
          localizingClosureProEtale Λ X K → localizingClosureProEtale Λ Z
            ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c.obj.obj).obj K)),
      ∃ α : ∀ (cf : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f)
          (cg : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification g)
          (cgf : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification (f ≫ g)),
          localizingLowerShriek Λ cf.obj.obj (hf cf) ⋙
              localizingLowerShriek Λ cg.obj.obj (hg cg) ≅
            localizingLowerShriek Λ cgf.obj.obj (hgf cgf),
        ∀ (cf : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f)
          (cg : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification g)
          (cgf : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification (f ≫ g))
          (df : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification f)
          (dg : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification g)
          (dgf : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification (f ≫ g))
          (rf : df.obj ⟶ cf) (rg : dg.obj ⟶ cg) (rgf : dgf.obj ⟶ cgf)
          (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory),
          (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ cg.obj.obj).map
              (compactificationRefinementComponent Λ rf K.obj) ≫
            compactificationRefinementComponent Λ rg
              ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ df.obj.obj.obj).obj K.obj) ≫
            ((α df.obj dg.obj dgf.obj).hom.app K).hom =
          ((α cf cg cgf).hom.app K).hom ≫
            compactificationRefinementComponent Λ rgf K.obj
